DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Rupture secondary to Previous Cesarean Section.

The ultrasound findings of a disruption in the uterine wall continuity adjacent to a prior scar, combined with hemoperitoneum, are pathognomonic for uterine rupture. This is a life-threatening obstetric emergency requiring immediate surgical intervention.
